failure.stage: runner preregistration validation before cache load
failure.reason: The runner recognized the earlier strict-path extractor amendment but did not yet recognize the separately sealed Val-only extractor/evaluator hashes.

change.behavior: Status and --include-val accept only the exact extractor and evaluator hashes already bound by the Val schema amendment. A non-Val run remains bound to the original/strict-path code set.

prohibitions: Do not use the Val amendment to rerun or replace TestA/TestB or Strict-TN2031 records.
Do not accept unbound code hashes.
